digest.component_or_area: plan clarity enforcement and P1 readiness gates
propositions: Empty parsed checklist items in Acceptance Criteria sections must be rejected by standalone clarity and P1 readiness gates
Unresolved sentinel tokens (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) in active execution sections must be detected and blocked when used as assigned values, ignoring fenced and inline code
Sentinel matches must be suppressed when the same line contains case-insensitive removal or negation terms (no, zero, remove, delete, reject, forbid, must not, without)
A shared pure parser must recognize standard checklist syntax and joined continuation lines to identify defective items without changing ticket-type exemptions
Plan-review P1 deterministic floor and standalone clarity check must enforce identical structural defects to preserve compatibility scoring
Implementation must include focused unit tests covering negative controls, edge cases, and cross-surface agreement between clarity and P1 gates
